subject: Proposal: temporary customer-scoped retention hold for forensic review
messages:
From: Marc Sloan <marc.sloan@valencehealthtech.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: forensic@valencehealthtech.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Request: temporary retention hold for tenant logs (Valence)

Hi Sofia,

We discovered anomalous activity tied to a small cohort of tenants in our account (Valence tenant IDs VHT-84xx). We need Redwood to place a temporary, scoped retention hold on the last 45 days of request/response and inference-telemetry logs for those tenants while our security team completes a forensic review. Expected window: 72 hours initially, may extend to 7 days depending on findings.

What we need from you:
- Confirmation you can stop scheduled deletion/purge for the specific tenant artifacts.
- A short attestation that logs will not be exported outside our approved storage during the hold.
- Names / emails of the Redwood contacts for chain-of-custody and evidence delivery.

I've attached a one-page scope doc (forensic_scope.pdf) describing the tenant IDs and the types of artifacts we need preserved.

Can you confirm by EOD? We are running on a tight timeline.

Thanks,
Marc Sloan
Head of InfoSec, Valence HealthTech
marc.sloan@valencehealthtech.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: forensic_scope.pdf (PDF, 98KB)

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
To: Marc Sloan <marc.sloan@valencehealthtech.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retention hold for tenant logs (Valence)

Marc — thanks for the note and for the scope doc. We can support a scoped retention hold for the specified tenant IDs; I'll loop in Security and Compliance for the attestation and chain-of-custody details.

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) Redwood will place a 72-hour hold on deletion for the listed tenant artifacts by 1200 UTC today.
2) Compliance will produce a short attestation (email + signed doc) confirming the artifacts will remain in secure storage and not be exported without your approval.
3) We'll provide a named point of contact for evidence transfer and will coordinate an encrypted transfer channel if needed.

Can you confirm the tenant IDs in the attached PDF are exhaustive? Also please confirm whether you want us to snapshot underlying object storage or only preserve current retention flags.

Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

On Tue, Jun 1, 2027 at 09:12 AM Marc Sloan <marc.sloan@valencehealthtech.com> wrote:

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 12:10:00 -0000
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary retention hold for tenant logs (Valence)

Team — forwarding Valence's ask. High level: scoped 45-day window, initial 72-hour hold, may extend. Marc asked for: confirmation we can stop automated deletion, attestation we won't export data outside approved storage, and names for chain-of-custody.

Action items for Compliance/Sec:
- Neha: can you draft the attestation and sign-off template (short email + redline doc) we can send to the customer? We may need to include our retention exception process and the limited scope.
- Karthik: can you confirm whether the platform supports an immediate retention-flag override per-tenant (yes/no) and whether we should perform an object-store snapshot (additional cost/procurement)? If snapshot is required, we should propose the minimal evidence package.

Proposed timeline: do hold by 12:00 UTC; attestation and chain-of-custody contact within 4 hours; deliverable to customer in same thread.

Quoted original from Marc included below for context.

-- Sofia

On Tue, Jun 1, 2027 at 11:03 AM Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com> wrote:
> (quoted) We can support a scoped retention hold for the specified tenant IDs...

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Marc Sloan <marc.sloan@valencehealthtech.com>, sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Proposal: temporary customer-scoped retention hold for forensic review

Marc / Sofia — thanks for the clear scope. Attached is a short temporary-hold agreement (redline_temporary_hold.docx) and a SIG/SOC2 mapping spreadsheet (sig_response.xlsx) that lists controls relevant to evidence handling and access.

Key points:
- Redwood confirms we can set a per-tenant deletion hold immediately; actioned at 12:00 UTC on Jun 1.
- Data will remain in customer-scoped encrypted storage and will not be exported outside your approved account without a signed written request from Valence (we will include this clause in the attached agreement).
- Chain-of-custody: primary contact for evidence transfer will be Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.com). He will coordinate a secure SFTP endpoint and sign an evidence transfer record.
- If you require immutable snapshots (object-store snapshot), that is available but will require an ops ticket and short approval; please indicate if you want snapshots in addition to the hold.

Please review the redline and the mapping and either: (A) sign the DocuSign link below, or (B) propose edits by EOD Jun 4 so we can keep the hold in place pending agreement.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/sign/EXAMPLE-hold-agreement

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: redline_temporary_hold.docx (Word, 45KB); sig_response.xlsx (Excel, 72KB)
